objectives.description: Identify or correct a person,thing and its defining properties.
objectives.rationale: Use the denial/assertion meanings with A1-D001 ser and002 estar, A1 interrogatives and B1-F166 quien/167 donde/168 como relative links. Required frames distinguish identifying,correcting one mistaken property and rejecting a whole claim. Negative no…sino, emphatic sí que and word-focus prosody are grammar/practice, not extra senses per sentence. B2 clefts/se trata de and broad nominalized lo de are not claimed.

objectives.description: Ask for and supply time,cause,purpose,place and manner information directly or indirectly.
objectives.rationale: Detalle/razón and clarification/reporting actions complement earlier A1-D016–019 and077–083 question/preposition/sensory prerequisites. Cover direct and indirect person,place,time,duration,manner,cause and purpose questions; exact B1-F029–032 temporal clauses,F097 causal como andF100 para que supply dependencies. Asking to confirm,confirming,and requesting correction use A2-D006 verdad/057 seguro and local cierto,not a new word per tag. A1-F297 price-only cuánto ADV is distinct from A1-D081 cuánto DET and A2-D173 broader amount-of-action ADV.

objectives.description: Open and sustain a connected event account including complication,response,outcome and evaluation.
objectives.rationale: Scenario closes across initial setting,unexpected event,attempt/action,recognition,response and eventual outcome: ocurrir/suceder,resultar,darse cuenta,conseguir,mientras,en cuanto,de pronto/de repente and favorable evaluation. A2-D054/B1-F286 contar story and A2-D055 pasar event remain earlier. B1-F013–020 aspect periphrases,046 el otro día,047 desde entonces,050 al principio,051 finalmente plus tense/reference prerequisites are required. A short same-sense sentence remains possible; connected narration is a practice objective,not proof of every word's minimum level. C199–203/218–222 same event connectors are shared proposals.

objectives.description: Embed bounded person,object and place descriptions in the account.
objectives.rationale: Reuse A1/A2 P identity/body/personality meanings, H object/home properties,T place/orientation and F quantity/quality comparisons. B1-F072 libre/073 ocupado remain proposed A1; F075 parecer conflicts with A2-D022 evaluation atA2,so a descriptive complement does not settle a new sense. B1-F078 cualidad/079 en general and bound relative links support selection of relevant properties. Embed description in a narrative but do not enumerate every topical noun again.

objectives.description: Ask for and express a personal judgment and distinguish it from reported information.
objectives.rationale: En mi opinión,opinar and razón support asking,giving and reporting a viewpoint. Reuse A1-D033/A2-D118 pensar cognitive atA1 versus B1-F277A2 disagreement; A1 creer and A2-D007 para mí/022 parecer assessment. Negated belief+present subjunctive and an attributed viewpoint are specified under grammar/quote. B1-C114 opinar/C204 en mi opinión shared. B1-C115 según source atB1 versus checked Pragmatics1.5.3 B2 concealed citation remains a separate explicit conflict in quote objective,not blanket certification of all source frames.

objectives.description: Ask for,evaluate and approve or disapprove an action or choice with reasons.
objectives.rationale: Ventaja/desventaja,merecer la pena and ordinary choice nouns cover beneficial/unfavorable feature,value relative to effort,and reason for approval/disapproval. Earlier A1 bien/mal,A2-D095 estupendo/096 perfecto and A2 comparisons are reusable. B1 evaluation+infinitive versus que+present subjunctive is a required construction contrast. Familiar quality,appropriateness and aesthetic judgment are covered through named earlier adjectives and C review meanings,not each intensified form as a word.

objectives.description: Invite and express agreement,disagreement or partial agreement without equating firmness with politeness.
objectives.rationale: Cover solicitation,acceptance,strong refusal,qualified dependence,partial agreement and a conceded counterpoint with estar de acuerdo,tener razón,a favor de/en contra de,qué va and depender de plus pero/aunque/sin embargo. Earlier A2-D016 claro INTJ and023 de acuerdo remain; repeated claro or stretched bueno are prosodic variants,not duplicate meanings. Agreement is not factual validation and support is not physical holding. Exact A2-D008/B1-F010 dependency and currentB1/A2 agreement conflicts remain.

objectives.description: Distinguish confidence,doubt and present conjecture from established knowledge.
objectives.rationale: Cierto,dudar,suponer complement B1-F081 evidente/082 duda andF023 puede que,024 a lo mejor,025 tal vez,026 posiblemente,027 probablemente,028 seguramente; earlier A2-D056 probable/057 seguro/009 puede ser remain. Both high confidence and lack of evidence are practiced without claiming certainty. Simple future present conjecture is explicit B1 Grammar9.1.4/Functions2.15; future-perfect/past-conditional conjecture remainsB2. Exact A1-F259 quizá A1 is individually preserved locally with quizás variant; B1 mood choices do not silently relevel the same uncertainty sense.

objectives.description: Express obligation,necessity and absence of obligation without confusing the latter with prohibition.
objectives.rationale: Reuse B1-F021 deber obligation/advice,018 tener que A2,092 obligatorio A2 and091 necesidad; A2-D063 ir a,064 tener que,065 hay que,083 necesario,084 permiso,085 se puede. No tener que/no hacer falta in an absence-of-obligation context must not be taught as prohibition; do not imply hay que supplies every inflected modal construction. Explicit imperatives,prohibir and no se puede are permission objective coverage. Personal versus impersonal obligation and suitable versus mandatory action are distinct practice scenarios.

objectives.description: Ask about knowledge,skill and memory; distinguish assertion,recall and competence.
objectives.rationale: Saber fact and recordar plus skill-evaluation genio/desastre supplement earlier A1-D082 conocer acquaintance and A2-D070 acordarse de/078 olvidar. Memory positive,negative and prompting functions2.24–2.26 reuse those meanings; recall is not first introduced merely by a past tense. Skill saber+infinitive,A1/A2-W practice and B1-W capacidad/habilidad are separate prerequisites,not fact-saber automatically. No tener ni idea is a bounded negative-knowledge phrase built with earlier tener,A1-F250 ni and B1-F273 idea; clause negation is explicitly required without every sentence becoming a word.

objectives.description: Explain liking,dislike,preference and indifference with correct experiencer and complement.
objectives.rationale: Importar/dar igual/harto distinguish relevance,indifference and being fed up. Reuse A1-D030 gustar/031 querer/072 preferir; A2-D011 venir bien/074 encantar/075 odiar/077 interesar and ordinary object choices. Positive and negative preference,asking about preference and comparison A versus B are covered; same-subject infinitive versus different-subject que+present subjunctive is grammar. B1-F269 matter importar versus B1-S031 import goods is not a merge.

objectives.description: Express hopes,wishes,intentions and unfulfilled plans with bounded mood and tense contrasts.
objectives.rationale: Ojalá,hope esperar,a ver si,aspirational soñar con/sueño and intención cover wanted outcomes,hopes and intended action; negative or frustrated plans use the same meanings with bounded time/negation. A1 esperar wait is explicitly distinct. Earlier ir a future intent and B1-F278 pensar intent remain. Wish formula que+present subjunctive,esperar que sí/no,and a future plan that did not happen require F tense-mood scoping; no claim of counterfactual past-subjunctive coverage.

objectives.description: Ask about and report joy,sadness,fun,boredom,annoyance,worry and nervousness.
objectives.rationale: Local fed-up/boredom/emotional-hurt meanings supplement exact earlier A1-P031 alegre; A2-P020 triste/021 contento/022 nervioso/024 enfadado/025 miedo,106 preocuparse,108 enfadarse,109 alegrarse and110 bored-state aburrido. B1-P096 alegría/103 asustado/104 estresado and108 molestar/109 emotional doler remain shared. Account for mood questions,joy,sadness,fun,boredom,annoyance,anger,worry and nervousness; causative versus experiencer pairs alegrar/alegrarse,aburrir/aburrirse,preocupar/preocuparse require valency-family authoring rather than automatic extra published senses. Local divertirse,pasarlo bien and reír close the enjoyment-action/laughter side,not merely one earlier adjective as a placeholder.

objectives.description: Respond empathetically,express relief,resignation,regret and embarrassment.
objectives.rationale: Ya acknowledgment,de verdad,vergüenza and no pasa nada cover attentive receipt,embarrassment,apology response and bounded reassurance. Earlier A2-D098 pena/079 lástima and002 recordar support regret about what occurred. B1 resignation frame así es la vida and relief ya está are declared fixed practice frames in exclusions,not automatic full-sentence vocabulary counts. Exact B1-P099/B1-C228 decepción is an independent earlier B1 noun proposal and remains a required lexical prerequisite here. Functions3.23 has an empty B1 column,but that functional inventory gap does not defer the already proposed noun or every way of expressing disappointment. Empathy does not require endorsing another person's factual claim.

objectives.description: React with surprise,admiration or affection while distinguishing event from experienced state.
objectives.rationale: Cover surprise,belief-checking,admiration and close-relationship affection with sorprenderse/extrañar,vaya,de verdad/en serio,increíble/impresionante and cariño; ordinary assessments can be brief. Earlier A2-P122 enamorarse and A2-D086 querer love support romantic change/affection; Local caer bien with required caer mal counterpart names impression-based liking; no earlier saved exact construction was found. No requirement to address strangers affectionately. Stimulus sorprender versus experiencer sorprenderse is explicit family valency scope,not proof of separate net-new entries.

objectives.description: Express familiar bodily needs and sensations without giving medical advice.
objectives.rationale: Reuse A1-P044 hambre/045 sed/046 sleepiness sueño and earlier cold/heat, A2-P pain/sensation meanings and B1-P054 cansarse. Quantification,body-part subjects and me duele/duelen agreement are required; physical versus emotional doler is individually distinguished locally. Feeling well/poorly reuses exact A2-P107 sentirse and local encontrarse well-being; no earlier encontrar-locate row supplies this new selected use. No diagnosis,treatment,danger thresholds or cooking safety advice is authored.

objectives.description: Give direct or softened instructions and ask for a favor,object or help.
objectives.rationale: Pedir,prestar,petición,orden,instrucción and contingency framing cover command,favor,object and help requests; earlier A2-D014 favor/015 dejar lending and A1 ayudar/ayuda/dar remain. Required direct imperative,softened imperative,conditional could/would-mind,infinitive written instruction and productive se instruction frames are named under grammar. Typical object/person/clitic and required preposition contrasts are explicit; not every polite full utterance a new word.

objectives.description: Accept,qualify,delay or refuse a request and make or withhold a commitment.
objectives.rationale: Cover unreserved acceptance,reserved acceptance,withheld commitment,attempt without guaranteed result,and polite refusal. Prometer/intentar/compromiso/acuerdo plus con mucho gusto and earlier de acuerdo/claro/bueno/es que provide contrasts; no pienso+infinitive strong refusal is a construction of intent,not a new verb. Commitment C067 B1 versus W184 B2 remains exact same-sense disagreement. No obligation to accept requests or forgive misconduct is implied.

objectives.description: Request,grant or refuse permission,recognize prohibition and a refusal to comply.
objectives.rationale: Dejar allow,prohibir,molestar and earlier poder permission/prohibido/se puede cover asking,granting with or without conditions,refusing,recognizing a ban and expressed defiance. B1 Functions4.12 is compositional indifference-to-ban,not a separate dangerous-action instruction or an excuse to ignore actual rules. No se puede and no debes contrasted with absence of necessity; subject/clitic/mood and impersonal/passive se are explicit.

objectives.description: Suggest,offer,invite,confirm a proposal and accept or decline with a reason.
objectives.rationale: Accept/reject/insist/propuesta plus earlier invitar,preferir,quedar and confirmation cover invitation,offer,counterchoice,confirmation and volunteered help. Exact A2-D146 quedar,basic booking confirm A2-D147 and A2-D148 cancelar are prerequisites,not every social context a new sense. B1 conditional modal suggestions,yo+conditional and y si+present indicative are required constructions; si yo fuera… counterfactual remains later. Propuesta B1 here versus W182/currentB2 is explicit unsettled lexical placement.

objectives.description: Give bounded advice and warnings and recognize evaluative reproach.
objectives.rationale: Aconsejar,recomendar,consejo and por si acaso cover helpful recommendation and precaution. Earlier cuidadoA2-D025 and B1-F021 deber with conditional/imperative forms cover warning; negative imperative and evaluative reproach are practiced without new words per sentence. Yo que tú / yo en tu lugar+conditional is bounded person-shift construction in Functions4.18/Pragmatics3.1,not an exhaustive idiom list. No actual medical,financial or safety advice is delivered.

objectives.description: Reassure,console and encourage without promising an unverified outcome.
objectives.rationale: No pasa nada with earlier negated preocuparse/enfadarse/llorar,permission to pause and selected doubt/hope vocabulary covers reassuring,consoling and encouraging. Do not promise recovery or safety as fact. Generic strength of encouragement comes from prosody and context; B2-specific ánimo/anímate and calm-down synonyms are later alternatives,not mandatory new B1 words.

objectives.description: Greet,address,introduce and welcome appropriately; request an introduction.
objectives.rationale: Estimado and disculpa complement exact earlier A1-D026–029/057–064 greetings,introduction reaction and gratitude; A2-D030 mucho gusto/031 bienvenido/039 querido written opening. Presentar A2-D003,conocerA1-D082 and B1-F169 reciprocal se enable introducing,asking whether people know each other and requesting an introduction. Señor/señora and professional forms from P/W are prerequisites; the date/time/context of greeting does not multiply senses. Written colon and recipient agreement are explicit.

objectives.description: Apologize for an ordinary problem and respond without automatically accepting responsibility.
objectives.rationale: Disculpa,disculparse,perdonar,culpa and malentendido cover apology,explanation,accepted apology and responsibility distinctions. Reuse A1 planned social01 perdón/social02 lo siento/social03 de nada and A2-D032 sentir regret,not a new word for every person/tense variant. Partial or declined acceptance is valid; no automatic causal blame or legal admission inferred.

objectives.description: Thank,respond,offer sympathy,toast,congratulate and reciprocate wishes.
objectives.rationale: Felicitar/chinchín complement A1-D029 gracias/068 salud toast/069 felicidades and A2-D033 enhorabuena/034 buena suerte/035 buen viaje/036 que aproveche/037 buen provecho/038 igualmente. Gratitude with por+NP,reciprocal thanks,condolence lo siento intensified appropriately,wishes for success,travel and recovery and birthday/holiday congratulations are explicit compositional practice obligations. No mandatory religious wording,alcohol or personal disclosure; not each calendar event a new lexical entry.

objectives.description: Transmit greetings and close face-to-face,phone and written exchanges.
objectives.rationale: Recuerdos,atentamente,hasta ahora/pronto complement A2-D040 un abrazo/041 besos/042 de parte de/051 saludos and A1 farewells. Sending greetings names recipient/source; response to transmitted greetings has B1-empty5.20 so no false B1 new formula claim. Propose/accept/reject a conversational close with earlier bueno/vale/es que/espera/irse and one next topic; reuse dates as slots rather than every farewell a new word.

objectives.description: Ask for a person,handle a wrong number or unavailable speaker,and leave a message.
objectives.rationale: Cortarse/confundirse/disculpa plus A2-D029 dígame,042 de parte de,043 un momento,044 ponerse,045 recado,073 extensión and existing llamar/oír/contestar cover caller/requested person,unavailable speaker,wrong number,message and broken signal. B1-C125 interruption is shared; A2-C144 answering a call is distinct from earlier replying to a message. F number/alphabet spelling primitives remain prerequisites. Exact B1-C126 pasar transferring a caller is an independent B1 lexical proposal; Functions6.3/6.4 place richer pasar/poner con routing constructions in B2. Preserve that lexical-versus-construction tension: the earlier proposal remains a dependency,not silently withheld or treated as full B2 routing grammar mastery.

objectives.description: Show interest and check that the other person can follow or hear.
objectives.rationale: Ya/vaya/en serio/de verdad supplement A2-D047 ajá/026 oye/027 mira and A1 eh/no tags. Ask if heard or understood; show interest without taking the floor; acknowledge without necessarily agreeing. Repeated/clitic/formal forms of perception verbs remain contact-control constructions rather than arbitrary quoted-utterance inventory. Regional entonation and lengthening require physical QA.

objectives.description: Introduce,continue and close ordered points without confusing time with argumentative organization.
objectives.rationale: First,next,another aspect,last point and conclusion are covered by en primer lugar/por un lado/por otro lado/por una parte/por otra parte,earlier primero/luego/después/por último and closing en conclusión/para terminar/al final. B1-F051 finalmente/F053 a continuación remain exact shared dependencies. En conclusión closing B1 versus recap B2 has a named function-granularity issue,not a forced new ID per label.

objectives.description: Connect addition,cause,result and concession in a reasoned familiar account.
objectives.rationale: Addition,reason-before-result,explanatory response,consequence and failed expectation have explicit selected forms: además,como,es que,así que,por eso,por lo tanto,aunque,sin embargo; earlier y/también/pero/porque remain. B1 sin embargo/por lo tanto versus current/F B2 disagreement is preserved. A pesar de/en cambio stay explicit B2 comparisons; no assumption one connector closes all connective functions.

objectives.description: Clarify a word or intended meaning,correct a misunderstanding and summarize.
objectives.rationale: Use es decir/o sea/querer decir for restatement,aclarar/confundirse/malentendido for repair,significado/sentido/explicación for the target and en resumen/resumir for compression. Earlier A2-D053 significar/071 equivocarse/090 explicar and A2-T106/A2-W052 corregir plus107/059 error are prerequisites. Ask for repetition,spelling,slower speech or meaning using earlier frames; every sentence is not a word. Resumir C229 and checked B2 lexical occurrences remain an explicit B1 proposal conflict.

objectives.description: Specify one aspect or introduce a new topic with a marked boundary.
objectives.rationale: En concreto/en particular/sobre todo select a detail or priority; en cuanto a introduces a bounded topic. Reuse earlier por ejemplo A1 as illustration and solo A2-F178 as restriction. Topic shift is not an automatically permitted B2 digression-management system. Capitals,italics,underlining and list layout are writing/form practices,not vocabulary senses.

objectives.description: Attribute a statement or question with explicit reporting verbs and track reference.
objectives.rationale: Afirmar/informar plus earlier decir/explicar/preguntar introduce named-source statements and questions. Required direct-quotation punctuation and speaker deixis; present reporting que/si/interrogative; B1 Grammar9.1.2 allows bounded past report with imperfect and9.2.1 present report of a command with present subjunctive. Pragmatics1.5.2 B2 more complete tense/deictic transposition remains a boundary; do not silently claim all backshift. Exact B1-C115 según source is an earlier B1 proposal against Pragmatics1.5.3 B2 implicit citation; retain that conflict and prohibit treating attribution as factual verification.

objectives.description: Interrupt politely,hold or yield the floor,resume and request quiet.
objectives.rationale: Interrumpir,continuar,callarse plus earlier un momento/por favor/decir/terminar and contact markers cover requesting the floor,holding it,yielding,resuming and asking for silence. Bare cállate may be rude; role/context and negative imperative/clitic placement require authoring. No arbitrary full metadiscourse quote list; pauses and turn transitions are assessed later through real dialogue/audio.

objectives.description: Give a polite complaint with relevant facts,remedy request and follow-up outcome.
objectives.rationale: A complete bounded flow is report relevant problem and timing,explain dissatisfaction,state desired remedy,respond to a constraint and report outcome. Queja/quejarse/reclamar,resolver/solucionar,sustituir,garantía/reembolso,estropearse and earlier request/apology/stance forms cover contrasts. B1-H/T/W product,service,application and digital meanings remain exact shared prerequisites; no universal consumer rights or legal deadlines. Longer complaint style does not force a relevel of earlier breakdown/returned-money meanings.

objectives.description: Individually dispose later argumentation and connector inputs without claiming they are all B1.
objectives.rationale: Refutar/respaldar/de hecho/en definitiva/por el contrario planned B2 inputs and baseline argumento/sostener/cuestionar/negociar,a pesar de/en cambio remain later dispositions. No obstante proposedB2 versus baselineC1 follows explicit B2 pragmatic evidence. Later specialist rhetorical/connotative/evidential/idiom inventories are not required to close these ordinary B1 scenarios; no sentence-length test is used as level proof.

objectives.description: Track participants and propositions with bounded relative,anaphoric and reported forms.
objectives.rationale: B1-F-reference and F166–168 selected relative links,earlier A1/A2 subject/tonic/object/possessive/demonstrative systems and A2-F clitic rows are required. Add explicit proposition-anaphoric lo/eso and verbal proforms hacer/decir/dar,second-mention definite articles,partial lexical repetition and indirect questions. F169 reciprocal contrasts mutually acting participants; no blanket B2 ellipsis,cataphora,clefts or free subjunctive-relative mastery. Exact reported-speech boundary is quote objective,not generic 'grammar covered'.

objectives.description: Require explicit B1 tense,mood and imperative realization of the selected functions.
objectives.rationale: Use B1-F-tense-paradigms: earlier present/imperfect/preterite/present-perfect/progressive; B1 productive simple future (including present conjecture),polite/modest/modal conditional,pluperfect and present subjunctive in wishes,evaluation,doubt,future time,purpose and current reported commands. Real si+present patterns differ from future-temporal cuando+subjunctive. Conditional could/would like,bounded quisiera and yo que tú frames do not prove productive past subjunctive. Negative imperative proclisis,affirmative enclisis,all relevant persons and irregular families must be authored; past subjunctive,counterfactual si,future/conditional perfect and full retrospective reporting remain later except named bounded exceptions.

objectives.description: Separate earlier bounded nonreflexive frames from productive B1 impersonal,passive and reciprocal se.
objectives.rationale: A1-D's cómo se dice classroom frame and A2-D085 se puede impersonal permission are earlier bounded nonreflexive prerequisites. A1-F030 reflexive/pronominal and A2-F030 le/les-replacement se do not supply impersonal/passive grammar. Explicit B1-F169 mutual reciprocal,F170 impersonal human actor,F171 passive-reflexive affected subject underpin B1 instructions/prohibitions. Subject-number agreement and absence/presence of actor/recipient are required checks. The frames are not automatically three new words each time a person/tense changes.

objectives.description: Reuse earlier basic questions,social formulas,negation,quantities and topical prerequisites.
objectives.rationale: D has no primary legacy-category ownership; relevant underlying meanings already enumerated by A1/A2 D/F/P/H/T/W/C remain required,not globally adjudicated. Exact A1-D001–052,054–083 and A2-D001–152/172–181 provide earlier information,social,affect,request,repair and basic narrative systems; D individually revisits later/problem/conflict-sensitive senses rather than repeating every unrelated topical record. Planned a1-social-planned-01/02/03/04/05 resolve respectively through A1-D054 perdón/055 lo siento/056 de nada/057 buenos días/060 hasta luego; pronunciation/alphabet/number/calendar prerequisites are F/W scope. W124/125 sending/receiving conflicts remain exact earlier C-versus-T decisions,not solved by a new D message.

objectives.description: Require respectful person forms and real speech-act/prosody review.
objectives.rationale: Carry tú/usted/vosotros/ustedes and regional vos variants with clitic,imperative and agreement forms; person form alone does not determine politeness. Regional vale frequency,coger physical-take versus other regional meanings,and greeting/phone conventions require labels rather than excluding whole varieties. B1-F/A1-W alphabet including ñ and regional letter names; numbers/calendar and spelling are earlier form prerequisites. Spoken QA must check statement/question/confirmation/reaction/request contours,pause groups,contrastive focus,MWE linkage,clitic stress and controlled rate. AI written notes are not native Spanish/Slovak approval or audio playback/listening.

objectives.description: Explain the actual B1-empty subcategories and the limited later boundary.
objectives.rationale: Checked Functions B1 empty cells:3.23 specified disappointment-function exponents (not the absence of all disappointment vocabulary: inherit B1-P099/B1-C228 decepción B1 as an independent earlier lexical proposal);4.5 pleading/4.6 reiterated-command formulas/4.20 threatening;5.20 response to transmitted greetings;6.18–6.20 digression opening,return and topic rejection. Pragmatics1.8 B1 interpreted-metaphor inventory is blank; this does not prevent ordinary earlier phrases or selected conventional person evaluations. No exhaustive swearword,irony,sarcasm,legal argument or specialized rhetorical inventory is necessary for B1 closure. Earlier/basic paraphrase remains possible; not-applicable means no separate inventory expansion here,not inability to communicate.
